records.scope: Reject zero residue positions before offset lookup; reject malformed compound components instead of silently dropping them.
records.limitations: Specific parser regressions, not a certification of all accepted genotypes or the complete design engine. The original baseline is intentionally retained; later caller/config changes still require context review.

records.scope: Drain subprocess diagnostics alongside SAM output, clean up failed children, reject malformed CIGAR and multi-record references.
records.limitations: IO/input guard tests do not calibrate MAPQ, validate every aligner version, or establish biological accuracy.

records.scope: Malformed completion records, stage/unit mismatch, invalid counts and missing regular FASTA files cannot certify a completed unit.
records.limitations: Bounded marker contracts, not a proof that every interrupted OS/process/IO state can be resumed.

records.scope: Device-export transfer volume must be finite and positive.
records.limitations: Numeric export guard only; no liquid-handler hardware validation or deck setup certification.

records.scope: Use the configured per-axis default when no finite Tm evidence exists; preserve finite values including zero.
records.limitations: A tested frontend calculation, not visual/browser/desktop usability acceptance or full frontend coverage.

records.scope: Registered host routing, explicit partial failures, atomic execution summary, error-state persistence and opt-in strict exits.
records.limitations: CLI-only outcome summary, not a full replay manifest or new GUI report integration. Custom codon-table import is separate.

records.scope: First-applicable gate precedence, inclusive indel boundary, legitimate multi-site designs, strict deletion/no-call subset and legacy advisories.
records.limitations: Synthetic behavior contracts, not sensitivity/specificity measurements or scientific threshold calibration. Enum order is not runtime priority.

records.scope: Pure original-read window coordinates agree with independent whole-read strand normalization, including asymmetric lengths and clipped ends.
records.limitations: The audited unit is coordinate extraction, not every behavior in the large demultiplexing module or a measured barcode misassignment rate.

records.scope: Distinguish actual passed, skipped, failed and missing external-test outcomes; synthetic cases do not fill missing external evidence.
records.limitations: Explicit inventory only; additional external-data tests may exist outside it. Its implementation passing does not mean the external tests executed.

unverified.reason: Approved independent biological labels and a shareable real-data fixture remain unavailable. External/private-data skips, read self-consistency and matched-rule samtools agreement are not biological ground truth.
MAPQ, mixture, indel, read-depth and primer thresholds require separate measured evidence. No operational threshold is calibrated or changed by this audit planner.
A workflow does not enforce protected-branch settings. Repository Administration permission and a verified settings change are still required; not implemented by this tooling.

Only the nine described historical scopes are recorded. Other audit findings, GUI integration of new CLI summaries, visual/hardware tests and full replay provenance are not certified by their regression tests.
